en.title: The Golden Race and the Ice‑Crystal Chronograph
en.premise: The eternal light generated by the energy of the "Seed" has turned the capital into a sleepless city. Yet beneath the prosperity, the world’s balance is fracturing, and an ancient northern bloodline sends an invitation to the "Ice Castle." Amid the glittering aristocrats cloaked in a golden race and the absolute‑zero silence that reigns over the frozen north, Julian and Erara set the gears of destiny in motion once more.

zh.title: 黄金赛与冰晶计时仪
zh.premise: “种子”的能量所带来的永恒之光，使王都化为不夜城。然而，在繁荣的背后，世界的平衡正在崩裂，北方的古老血脉向“冰之城”送去邀请函。金色赛跑装点的贵族们的虚饰与绝对零度的寂静统治的北境交织，Julian 与 Erara 再次启动命运的齿轮。
